name: Formik · Basic Example

title.zh: Formik · 先核对表单状态与字段 API

description.zh: Use the actual Overview-to-Basic official example page and require its native iframe Preview form to render before accepting proof. Do not submit, log in, fork, edit or rebuild the example; compilation, access walls and empty preview remain held. Formik 为 React 与 React Native 管理表单状态、校验和提交，文档提供字段、数组、错误提示与多步骤表单的接口。Overview 解释这三项职责，官方 Basic 页面把 Formik、Field、Form 代码与已渲染的姓名、邮件输入和提交按钮并列。可按自己的业务规则接入校验，原例的等待与 alert 不代表真实注册服务。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Formik (https://formik.org/).
Technology stack: react, react-native.
Component specification: Use the actual Overview-to-Basic official example page and require its native iframe Preview form to render before accepting proof. Do not submit, log in, fork, edit or rebuild the example; compilation, access walls and empty preview remain held.


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
